outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: 858 mother-baby dyads, 500 with mothers of normal weight (preconception BMI 18.5-24.9) and 500 with obese mothers (preconception BMI ≥ 30)
finding: Obese women are more likely to experience maternal complications and neonatal morbidity compared to normal-weight mothers.
mod_finding: Obese women were more likely to have cesarean sections compared to normal weight mothers.
